bio.text: Jennifer Canady represents District 50, part of Polk County, in the Florida House of Representatives, to which Canady was first elected in 2022.
Canady is a teacher who lives in Lakeland, where Canady was born.
Canady holds a bachelor's degree in elementary education from Florida State University and a master's degree in special education from the University of South Florida.
